cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Python Engineer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities: You can expect to work across the whole stack, from front-end code, through back-end services, serverless, SQL, to name but a few. Our current stack: Python, JavaScript, AngularJS, and Mongo. This is what you can expect to work with, but we are always open to using other technologies where they add value! Our development engineers lead by championing a culture of personal ownership and customer-focused execution. We love those who pride themselves in how they contribute through excellent solutions and end-user experiences, as much as clean and clear code. We are an Agile development shop and interact regularly with project stakeholders, including demos from each sprint. To support this methodology, we use regular retrospectives and objective measurements to drive continuous improvement and empower our developers to make informed technology and implementation decisions. As part of the development process, you will be involved in design sessions and you'll have the opportunity to learn and teach through peer review of code and of completed solutions.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years' experience in software engineering
Application development in Python
Unit testing and mocking frameworks (unit test, pytest, etc.)
Git for source control
Knowledge of OO concepts and design patterns
Preferred Requirements
SQL and relational database concepts
Experience with Pandas and NumPy

[Company name masked] is an agile development shop and demos work to project stakeholders. To support this methodology, continuous integration is practiced, open-source software is embraced, and developers are empowered to make informed technology and product decisions.
Reporting to the Development Manager you will be part of the Engineering team based in [Location masked]. Most people become stronger in this kind of engineering work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0401.responsibilities: You can expect to work across the whole stack, from front-end code, through back-end services, serverless, SQL, to name but a few. Our current stack: Python, JavaScript, AngularJS, and Mongo. This is what you can expect to work with, but we are always open to using other technologies where they add value! Our development engineers lead by championing a culture of personal ownership and customer-focused execution. We love those who pride themselves in how they contribute through excellent solutions and end-user experiences, as much as clean and clear code. We are an Agile development shop and interact regularly with project stakeholders, including demos from each sprint. To support this methodology, we use regular retrospectives and objective measurements to drive continuous improvement and empower our developers to make informed technology and implementation decisions. As part of the development process, you will be involved in design sessions and you'll have the opportunity to learn and teach through peer review of code and of completed solutions.
cond_0401.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years' experience in software engineering
Application development in Python
Unit testing and mocking frameworks (unit test, pytest, etc.)
Git for source control
Knowledge of OO concepts and design patterns, SQL and relational database concepts
Preferred Requirements
Experience with Pandas and NumPy
cond_0401.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0401.values: We value excellence in execution and a clear focus on results. We aim to produce work that reflects high standards and a strong commitment to performance.
